facts.label: Name
facts.value: The Learning Curve

facts.label: What it is
facts.value: An independent media and intelligence platform exploring the technologies, ideas, research and innovations transforming how the world learns. We connect the people shaping learning with the insights, evidence and tools to make better decisions.

facts.label: Website
facts.value: https://thelearningcurve.net

facts.label: First articles published
facts.value: 30 October 2026

facts.label: What it publishes
facts.value: The Library (one evergreen page per learning principle), Guides (practical course and instructional design), Reviews (course platforms scored with one published method) and Trends (dated news on online education).

facts.label: Who it's for
facts.value: Course creators, instructional designers, L&D teams, educators and the people who choose learning technology for their organisations.

facts.label: Not to be confused with
facts.value: The Learning Curve at thelearningcurve.net is not connected to other businesses, podcasts or publications with the same name.

facts.label: Founder
facts.value: Jim Lounsbury, who reviews, edits and approves every article before it's published.

facts.label: Jim Lounsbury's work
facts.value: A learning designer and documentary filmmaker based in Sydney, Australia.

facts.label: Educational development
facts.value: Jim works in educational development at Avondale University, designing course content and microcredentials.

facts.label: Other business
facts.value: Jim runs CredentialCraft, a course-design studio.

facts.label: Film and television
facts.value: Jim has made documentaries and factual television in more than 20 countries, seen on Apple TV, Prime Video, Stan and National Geographic, among others.

facts.label: How it's funded
facts.value: Affiliate links and clearly labelled advertising.

facts.label: Affiliate relationships
facts.value: Current or applied for with Thinkific, LearnWorlds, Teachable, Kajabi and TalentLMS.

facts.label: Sponsored content
facts.value: None. No company pays for coverage, and no article is sponsored.

facts.label: Ads on reviews
facts.value: Never. Advertising doesn't appear on platform reviews or comparisons.

facts.label: Commissions and scores
facts.value: Affiliate commissions never affect a score, a ranking or whether a platform is covered.

facts.label: Our co-founder's business
facts.value: CredentialCraft is mentioned only where it genuinely helps the reader, and is never ranked or scored against the platforms reviewed.

facts.label: Review method
facts.value: Seven criteria scored 1 to 5: learning design (retrieval, assessment, credentials, learner analytics) weighted 60%, business tools (pricing, payments, marketing) weighted 40%.

facts.label: How platforms are tested
facts.value: A real course is built on each platform, comparing the cheapest plan that includes certificates.

facts.label: Sources
facts.value: Each research claim links to its source.

facts.label: Library updates
facts.value: Each Library page is re-checked against new research every year.

facts.label: Use of AI
facts.value: AI tools help research and scaffold articles; every article is reviewed, edited and approved by a person before publication. Illustrations are sometimes AI-generated. Research excerpts and charts are built from the cited studies.

facts.label: Corrections and suggestions
facts.value: hello@thelearningcurve.net

facts.label: Newsletter
facts.value: Monthly, sent with Beehiiv, with a one-click unsubscribe in every email.

facts.label: Email addresses
facts.value: Never sold or rented.
